magicLink.subject: Your sign-in link for {staff}
magicLink.preview: Your link to sign in to {staff}
magicLink.reason: You're receiving this because someone asked to sign in to {staff} with this email address. If that wasn't you, you can ignore this email: nobody can sign in without this link.
magicLink.heading: Sign in to {staff}
magicLink.body: {minutes, plural, one {Use the button below to sign in. The link works once and expires in # minute.} other {Use the button below to sign in. The link works once and expires in # minutes.}}

resetPassword.subject: Reset your password for {staff}
resetPassword.reason: You're receiving this because someone asked to reset the password for this email address. If that wasn't you, you can ignore this email: your password stays the same.
resetPassword.heading: Reset your password
resetPassword.body: We received a request to reset the password of your account on {staff}. Choose a new one with the button below. The link expires in 1 hour.

verifyEmail.subject: Verify your email address for {staff}
verifyEmail.preview: Confirm this is your email address
verifyEmail.reason: You're receiving this because someone asked to verify this email address for an account on {staff}. If that wasn't you, you can ignore this email.
verifyEmail.heading: Verify your email address
verifyEmail.body: Confirm that this email address belongs to you. Once it's verified, accounts with the same address at a provider you can sign in with (such as GitHub) can connect to your account automatically. The link expires in 1 hour.

twoFactorCode.subject: Your sign-in code for {staff}
twoFactorCode.reason: You're receiving this because someone signed in to {staff} with your password, or turned on email codes for your account. If that wasn't you, change your password right away.
twoFactorCode.heading: Your sign-in code
twoFactorCode.intro: Enter this code to continue signing in:
twoFactorCode.note: {minutes, plural, one {The code expires in # minute. Never share it with anyone.} other {The code expires in # minutes. Never share it with anyone.}}

inviteLinkConfirmation.subject: Confirm your email to join {company}
inviteLinkConfirmation.preview: {target, select, staff {One more step to join {staff}} other {One more step to join {company} on {staff}}}
inviteLinkConfirmation.reason: You're receiving this because someone used an invite link for {company} with this email address. If that wasn't you, you can ignore this email.
inviteLinkConfirmation.heading: Confirm your email address
inviteLinkConfirmation.body: You opened an invite link for {company}. Confirm this is your email address to join as {role}.
inviteLinkConfirmation.note: {days, plural, one {The link works once and expires in # day.} other {The link works once and expires in # days.}}

alreadyMember.subject: {target, select, staff {You're already a member of {staff}} other {You're already a member of {company} on {staff}}}
alreadyMember.reason: You're receiving this because someone tried to invite this email address to {company}.
alreadyMember.heading: You're already a member
alreadyMember.body: {target, select, staff {Someone tried to invite you to {staff}, but you're already a member. No action is needed.} other {Someone tried to invite you to {company} on {staff}, but you're already a member. No action is needed.}}

alreadyInvited.subject: {target, select, staff {You already have an invitation to {staff}} other {You already have an invitation to {company} on {staff}}}
alreadyInvited.reason: You're receiving this because someone used an invite link for {company} with this email address. If that wasn't you, you can ignore this email.
alreadyInvited.heading: You already have an invitation
alreadyInvited.body: {target, select, staff {You opened an invite link for {staff}, but this email address already has an open invitation there. Use the invitation email you received earlier to join.}}
alreadyInvited.expired: If that invitation has expired, ask whoever invited you to send you a new one.

addedToCompany.subject: You were added to {company} on {staff}
addedToCompany.preview: You now have access to {company} on {staff}
addedToCompany.reason: {by, select, none {You're receiving this because your account was added to {company}.} other {You're receiving this because {adder} added your account to {company}.}}
addedToCompany.heading: You were added to {company}
addedToCompany.body: {by, select, none {You were added to {company} on {staff} as {role}.} other {{adder} added you to {company} on {staff} as {role}.}}

accountCreated.subject: Your account on {staff} is ready
accountCreated.reason: You're receiving this because {creator} of {staff} created an account for this email address. If you weren't expecting it, you can ignore this email.
accountCreated.heading: Your account on {staff} is ready
accountCreated.body: {creator} of {staff} created an account for you. Choose a password to sign in.
accountCreated.note: {days, plural, one {The link works once and expires in # day. You can also sign in with a link sent to this address at {signInUrl}.} other {The link works once and expires in # days. You can also sign in with a link sent to this address at {signInUrl}.}}

staffAdminAdded.subject: {name} is now a staff Admin on {staff}
staffAdminAdded.reason: You're receiving this because you're a staff Admin on {staff}: staff Admins are told whenever someone becomes one.
staffAdminAdded.heading: {name} is now a staff Admin
staffAdminAdded.made: {who} was made a staff Admin on {staff}.
staffAdminAdded.acceptedFrom: {who} accepted {by}’s invitation and is now a staff Admin on {staff}.
staffAdminAdded.accepted: {who} accepted an invitation to the staff and is now a staff Admin on {staff}.
staffAdminAdded.reactivatedBy: {by} reactivated the account of {who}, which is a staff Admin on {staff} again.
staffAdminAdded.reactivated: The account of {who} was reactivated and is a staff Admin on {staff} again.
staffAdminAdded.advice: Staff Admins can manage everything on {staff}, the staff included. If you don't recognise this, remove their staff access in the staff settings and check the audit log.

smtpChanged.subject: {staff} sends email through another mail server
smtpChanged.reason: You're receiving this because you're a staff Admin on {staff}: staff Admins are told whenever the mail server changes.
smtpChanged.heading: The mail server changed
smtpChanged.changedBy: {by} changed the mail server {staff} sends email through to {server}.
smtpChanged.changed: The mail server {staff} sends email through was changed to {server}.
smtpChanged.advice: Whoever controls the mail server can read the sign-in links and codes {staff} sends. If you don't recognise this, check the Email settings and the audit log.

smtpTest.subject: {staff} can send email through this mail server
smtpTest.reason: You're receiving this because you're saving a mail server on the Email tab of Settings.
smtpTest.heading: This mail server works
smtpTest.body: {staff} sent this test email through {server} before saving it as the mail server. It reached you, so emails can go out through it.

jobFailing.subject: Background job {job} keeps failing on {staff}
jobFailing.reason: You're receiving this because you're a staff Admin on {staff}: staff Admins are told when a background job keeps failing, at most once a day per job.
jobFailing.heading: {job} keeps failing
jobFailing.recurring: {count, plural, one {The background job {job} failed its last run.} other {The background job {job} failed its last # runs in a row.}} The other jobs keep running, but this one won't do its work until the problem is fixed.
jobFailing.queued: {count, plural, one {A {job} job was given up after its last attempt, so it won't run again on its own.} other {# {job} jobs were given up after their last attempt, so they won't run again on their own.}}
jobFailing.advice: Look up the error under Logs → Errors to see what went wrong.

securityNotice.reason: {kind, select, password_sign_in_paused {You're receiving this because of failed sign-in attempts on your account on {staff}. We send it at most once a day.} account_deleted {You're receiving this because your account on {staff} was deleted. We send it once, to the address the account had.} two_factor_locked {You're receiving this because of failed sign-in attempts on your account on {staff}. We send it once each time signing in with a code is paused.} impersonation_started {You're receiving this because a staff member signed in to {staff} as you. We send it every time, so you always know.} other {You're receiving this because a security setting changed on your account on {staff}. We always send these, so you know about every change.}}
securityNotice.ifNotYou: {kind, select, account_deactivated {If you didn't expect this, contact your administrator.} company_role_changed {If you didn't expect this, contact your administrator.} removed_from_company {If you didn't expect this, contact your administrator.} account_deleted {If you didn't expect this, contact your administrator.} signed_out_everywhere {If you didn't expect this, contact your administrator.} account_reactivated {If you didn't expect this, contact your administrator.} staff_role_granted {If you didn't expect this, contact your administrator.} staff_role_changed {If you didn't expect this, contact your administrator.} staff_role_removed {If you didn't expect this, contact your administrator.} mfa_reset {If you didn't ask for this, contact your administrator right away and change your password.} password_sign_in_paused {If this wasn't you, someone may be guessing your password. Make sure it's one you don't use anywhere else, or add a passkey.} two_factor_locked {If this wasn't you, someone may know your password. Change it right away, and make sure it's one you don't use anywhere else.} impersonation_started {If you didn't expect this, contact your administrator.} other {If this wasn't you, reset your password right away and contact your administrator.}}

password_changed.subject: Your password for {staff} was changed
password_changed.heading: Your password was changed
password_changed.body: The password of your account on {staff} was changed, and you were signed out on your other devices.

password_added.subject: A password was added to your account on {staff}
password_added.heading: A password was added
password_added.body: You can now also sign in to {staff} with your email address and this password.

password_reset.subject: Your password for {staff} was reset
password_reset.heading: Your password was reset
password_reset.body: The password of your account on {staff} was reset with a link sent to this address, and you were signed out everywhere.

two_factor_enabled.subject: Two-step verification is on for your account on {staff}
two_factor_enabled.heading: Two-step verification is on
two_factor_enabled.body: Signing in to {staff} with your password now also needs a code.

two_factor_disabled.subject: Two-step verification was turned off for your account on {staff}
two_factor_disabled.heading: Two-step verification was turned off
two_factor_disabled.body: Signing in to {staff} with your password no longer needs a code.

backup_codes_regenerated.subject: New backup codes for your account on {staff}
backup_codes_regenerated.heading: You have new backup codes
backup_codes_regenerated.body: New backup codes were created for your account on {staff}. Your old backup codes no longer work.

passkey_added.subject: A passkey was added to your account on {staff}
passkey_added.heading: A passkey was added
passkey_added.body: A new passkey can now be used to sign in to {staff}.

passkey_removed.subject: A passkey was removed from your account on {staff}
passkey_removed.heading: A passkey was removed
passkey_removed.body: One of your passkeys can no longer be used to sign in to {staff}.

provider_connected.subject: {provider} was connected to your account on {staff}
provider_connected.heading: {provider} was connected
provider_connected.body: You can now sign in to {staff} with your {provider} account.

provider_disconnected.subject: {provider} was disconnected from your account on {staff}
provider_disconnected.heading: {provider} was disconnected
provider_disconnected.body: Your {provider} account can no longer be used to sign in to {staff}.

mfa_reset.subject: Your two-step verification for {staff} was reset
mfa_reset.heading: Your two-step verification was reset
mfa_reset.body: An administrator turned off two-step verification for your account on {staff}, usually because a phone was lost. Any GitHub or Google accounts connected to your account were disconnected, and you were signed out everywhere. Set up two-step verification again on your Security page.

signed_out_everywhere.subject: You were signed out of {staff}
signed_out_everywhere.heading: You were signed out everywhere
signed_out_everywhere.body: An administrator signed you out of {staff} on every device. Sign in again to continue.

account_deactivated.subject: Your account on {staff} was deactivated
account_deactivated.heading: Your account was deactivated
account_deactivated.body: Your account on {staff} was deactivated, and you can't sign in until an administrator reactivates it.

account_reactivated.subject: Your account on {staff} was reactivated
account_reactivated.heading: Your account was reactivated
account_reactivated.body: An administrator reactivated your account on {staff}. You can sign in again.

staff_role_granted.subject: You now have staff access to {staff}
staff_role_granted.heading: You now have staff access
staff_role_granted.body: An administrator made you staff on {staff}, as {role}. You can now work with every company.

staff_role_changed.subject: Your staff role on {staff} changed
staff_role_changed.heading: Your staff role changed
staff_role_changed.body: An administrator changed your staff role on {staff} to {role}.

staff_role_removed.subject: Your staff access to {staff} was removed
staff_role_removed.heading: Your staff access was removed
staff_role_removed.body: An administrator removed your staff access to {staff}. Your account and any company memberships stay.

password_sign_in_paused.subject: Password sign-in to your account on {staff} is paused
password_sign_in_paused.heading: Password sign-in is paused
password_sign_in_paused.body: A wrong password was entered for your account on {staff} too many times, so signing in with a password is paused for a while. No one signed in: the password wasn't accepted. You can still sign in with an email link or a passkey, and resetting your password lifts the pause.

company_role_changed.subject: Your role in {company} on {staff} changed
company_role_changed.heading: Your role in {company} changed
company_role_changed.body: Your role in {company} on {staff} was changed to {role}.

removed_from_company.subject: You were removed from {company} on {staff}
removed_from_company.heading: You were removed from {company}
removed_from_company.body: You were removed from {company} on {staff}, so you can no longer open it. Your account and your other companies stay.

account_deleted.subject: Your account on {staff} was deleted
account_deleted.heading: Your account was deleted
account_deleted.body: An administrator deleted your account on {staff}, with its sign-in methods and company memberships. You can't sign in with it any more.

two_factor_locked.subject: Signing in to your account on {staff} with a code is paused
two_factor_locked.heading: Signing in with a code is paused
two_factor_locked.body: A wrong code was entered for the two-step verification of your account on {staff} too many times, so signing in with a code is paused for 15 minutes. No one signed in: the codes weren't accepted.

impersonation_started.subject: {name} from {staff} signed in as you
impersonation_started.heading: {name} signed in as you
impersonation_started.body: {minutes, plural, one {{name} from {staff} signed in as you, to see what you see and check what isn't working. It ends after at most # minute. Meanwhile, nobody can change your sign-in methods, your account or anyone's access. If you'd rather staff didn't sign in as you, you can turn it off on your Security page.} other {{name} from {staff} signed in as you, to see what you see and check what isn't working. It ends after at most # minutes. Meanwhile, nobody can change your sign-in methods, your account or anyone's access. If you'd rather staff didn't sign in as you, you can turn it off on your Security page.}}

requestUpdate.subject: {reference}: {title}
requestUpdate.preview: {event, select, reply {{name} replied.} status {{name} changed the status.} assigned {{name} assigned this request to you.} mentioned {{name} mentioned you.} note {{name} wrote an internal note.} raised {{name} raised this request for you.} other {{name} subscribed you to this request.}}
requestUpdate.reason: {role, select, assignee {You’re receiving this because this request is assigned to you. You can turn off emails about requests in <account>your account</account>.} other {You’re receiving this because you’re subscribed to this request. To stop, open the request and choose Unsubscribe, or turn off emails about requests in <account>your account</account>.}}
requestUpdate.noteOnlyStaff: Internal note: only the staff see this.
requestUpdate.files: {count, plural, one {# file attached, to download from the request:} other {# files attached, to download from the request:}}
requestUpdate.status: {change, select, reopened {{name} reopened this request.} done {{name} marked this request as done.} cancelled {{name} cancelled this request.} proposed {{name} proposed a solution.} approved {{name} approved the solution.} denied {{name} didn’t approve the solution.} other {{name} changed the status from {from} to {to}.}}
requestUpdate.mentioned: {where, select, description {{name} mentioned you in the description:} note {{name} mentioned you in an internal note:} other {{name} mentioned you in a reply:}}
requestUpdate.answerNote: Approving closes the request. Denying sends it back to the staff, and you can then tell them what’s still wrong. These buttons work only for you, and only once.
requestUpdate.noReply: Replies to this email aren’t read. To answer, open the request.
requestUpdate.signInNote: {days, plural, one {The links in this email sign you in to {staff} for # day, so don’t forward it.} other {The links in this email sign you in to {staff} for # days, so don’t forward it.}}

webhookTurnedOff.subject: The webhook “{name}” was turned off
webhookTurnedOff.reason: You’re receiving this because you’re a staff Admin on {staff}, who set up webhooks.
webhookTurnedOff.heading: The webhook “{name}” is off
webhookTurnedOff.why: {reason, select, gone {Its receiver answered that it’s gone for good (410 Gone), so it was turned off automatically.} unreadable {Its address or signing secret can’t be read with the current auth secrets any more, so it was turned off automatically.} other {Every delivery to it has failed for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, so it was turned off automatically.}}
webhookTurnedOff.advice: Nothing is sent to it while it’s off, and what happens meanwhile isn’t sent later. Once its receiver works again, turn it on in Settings, where its last deliveries show what went wrong.
webhookTurnedOff.adviceUnreadable: Nothing is sent to it while it’s off. Enter its address again and renew its secret in Settings, then turn it on.
